Overview

Paraná is a city in Entre Ríos with a population of 339,930. Entre Ríos’ capital on the Paraná River with a historic tunnel, cathedral, and Carnival celebrations. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
